# State of AI coding assistants, 2026

## Adoption is broad; trust is not

- 84% of professional developers are using or planning to use AI coding tools [1]
- Only 29% of professional developers trust the accuracy of AI tooling for complex tasks [2]
- Developers accepted just over 30% of Copilot's code suggestions [3]
- The strongest system completed 41% of tasks end-to-end without human intervention [4]
- Task completion drops sharply for tasks requiring more than three file edits [5]
- Adoption of AI coding agents reached 38% this year, up from 21% a year earlier [6]
- Annual spend on coding agents grew to $1.2B [7]
- High-risk AI system obligations apply from 2 August 2026 [8]
- The strongest system completed 91% of tasks end-to-end without human intervention [9]
- Vendors charge $19 per seat per month [10]

## Verification summary

- claims checked: 10
- verified: 8
- not verified: 2
- unique source domains: 6

## Methods

Every claim above was re-fetched from its cited URL and checked by deterministic numeric comparison before any model judgement.
